violated_contract: A monitoring dashboard panel added or edited inside a budget-audited dashboard JSON must satisfy that dashboard's checked-in query-budget contract (rate()/increase() range windows no wider than the sanctioned bound on timeseries panels; day-scale aggregates use $__range so they evaluate once). A panel merged in the same file as passing guard tests still regresses the batch budget when it lands after the audit without the guard running on main.
canonical_prevention: Every dashboard JSON change runs the budget contract test in the PR's own CI on the exact head (never rely on an earlier same-file green), and new day-scale aggregates copy the $__range pattern from the existing instant panels instead of pinning a fixed [Nd] window.
